task.title: Repair canonical auto-integrator receipt reconciliation for registry repositories

owned: .orchestrator/multi_repo_registry.py repository scope validation and task_repository_slug_and_default_branch helper
.orchestrator/rewrite/integration_receipt.py frozen_delivery_binding multi-repo resolution, exclusive flock/inode/device lock authority, and malformed receipt rejection
scripts/git/auto_integrator.py thread config to integration_receipt_consumes_candidate and held descriptor device/inode binding
.orchestrator/rewrite/test_integration_receipt.py multi-repo receipt, exclusive flock authority, and unchanged state/journal regression tests
scripts/git/test_auto_integrator.py candidate consumption, descriptor binding, and execute-plans regression tests
not_changing: auto-integrator candidate selection or GitHub merge gate
task state store architecture or receipt store schema
second integrator, receipt store, cron, gate, status API, or direct merge path

root_cause_analysis.defect: The sole canonical auto-integrator merged execute-plans PR #747, but receipt reconciliation failed with 'delivery binding no longer matches the revalidated snapshot'. Subsequent re-review identified P1 (missing flock/inode kernel lock verification) and P2 (silent overwrite of malformed/unknown-version receipts). Further re-review identified that lock authority accepted shared locks (LOCK_SH caused EAGAIN on LOCK_EX probe) and auto_integrator captured expected inode via stat(lock_path) rather than fstat of the descriptor acquired by lock_file.
root_cause_analysis.mechanism:
1) Multi-repo delivery binding: scripts/git/auto_integrator.py passed selected registry repo slug ('ajoe734/execute-plans') to rewrite.integration_receipt, but frozen_delivery_binding hardcoded repo validation to {'pantheon', 'ajoe734/pantheon'}, returning None and causing mismatch rejection.
2) Exclusive lock authority: rewrite/integration_receipt.py probed with LOCK_EX which raised EAGAIN when only LOCK_SH was held. auto_integrator.py captured expected inode from stat(lock_path) at receipt time rather than fstat of the descriptor acquired by lock_file, allowing a replaced file with matching metadata to pass.
3) Malformed receipt rejection: _apply_receipt_to_state treated parse_integration_receipt failure as absence, silently overwriting unknown-version or malformed receipts on disk.
root_cause_analysis.repair:
1) Multi-repo delivery binding: Extended frozen_delivery_binding and integration_receipt_consumes_candidate to resolve repo slug and default branch via multi_repo_registry.task_repository_slug_and_default_branch with pure predicate semantics.
2) Exclusive lock authority: Implemented _verify_lock_authority to probe with nonblocking LOCK_SH (which succeeds on shared or unlocked locks and fails only when exclusively held), verify /proc/locks kernel table for unique FLOCK ADVISORY WRITE ownership by expected PID, device, and inode, and verify expected_device and expected_inode bound from fstat of descriptor acquired by lock_file in auto_integrator.
3) Malformed receipt rejection: In _apply_receipt_to_state, if raw_existing = task.get(RECEIPT_KEY) is not None and parse_integration_receipt returns None, raise IntegrationReceiptConflictError immediately before mutating flat state or V2 journal. Added writer and integrator regressions verifying unchanged state and journal on rejection.
